geeklist.title: [CLOSED] Quick In-Time For Christmas Auction (Closes 12/7/2025)
geeklist.description:
Usual rules apply:
1. All games will be listed with a starting bid. Some items have a Buy-it-Now value. If a game doesn't go for at least the listed starting bid, I won't be selling it.
2. Bids must be posted in whole dollar amounts in USD.
3. Transactions will be done through PayPal or Venmo and I will be using the BGG Marketplace to make sure BGG gets its 3%. Payment is due within two days of auction closing, please. After that I can assume the bid is forfeit. Please include 3% extra to cover Goods and Services if using PayPal.
4. I'll ship U.S. only using the best rates possible. Usually that's flat rate but I'll make an effort to find cheaper if it exists. I'm shipping from 01867. Local pickup north of Boston area is available. If you would like to provide me a shipping label, that's fine, but please only request that if you can actually ship things cheaper than my option.
5. The auction closes 12/7/2025 at 9:00 p.m. CDT (BGG site time). Any last minute bids extend the auction. A single item's auction closes 30 minutes after the last bid.
6. I will try to get every game out within 3 business days of payment. If there are a lot of games to ship, or if something in life gets in the way, this may affect the time table. I'll be communicative with buyers.
7. Some games are listed on BGG marketplace and thus may be sold elsewhere. If they are sold, I'll mark it clearly in the auction.
8. If you need to delete your bid for any reason, please leave a comment and shoot me a quick message.
9. I reserve the right to not sell any game of any reason. This will usually only happen because the buyer is being a jerk.
10. I will not split any lots/bundles.
11. If there is an issue with the shipping, you must let me know within 30 days of the shipping date. Otherwise, it becomes difficult for the USPS or UPS to help in any way.
Anyone who BINs a game may optionally choose one of these free games to be included: * Greed (https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/151247/greed) * One Night Revolution (https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/176361/one-night-revolut...) * The Agents (without a box, https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/141932/agents) * Trickster: Champions of Time (https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/218310/trickster-champio...) * Alien Artifacts (https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/181293/alien-artifacts)
